task_summary: Customer requests to exchange Premium Cotton Shirt from ORD-6034 for Premium Cotton Shirt (Large). Correct handling: apply exchange policy, preview exchange details, confirm with customer, and process payment or store credit based on price difference. If new item costs more, charge difference; if less, issue store credit.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the exchange policy before handling the exchange request.
Agent must make a process_exchange preview tool call for ITEM-9250 to PROD-2251 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true process_exchange tool call.

opening_message: I would like to exchange the Premium Cotton Shirt from order ORD-6034 for a Premium Cotton Shirt in size Large.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to exchange the Premium Cotton Shirt from order ORD-6034 for the Premium Cotton Shirt in size Large. If the agent provides a valid exchange preview and asks for confirmation, agree to proceed.
known_info: You purchased a Premium Cotton Shirt in order ORD-6034.
You want the Premium Cotton Shirt in Large size instead.
unknown_info: You are not aware of the exchange price-difference policy.
task_rules: Do not request a different product. Confirm once a valid preview is offered.
